case.question: What are the seven overarching Artemis III science objectives?
case.gold_answer: They are understanding planetary processes, lunar polar volatiles, Earth-Moon impact history, the ancient sun and astronomical environment, observing the universe and local space environment, experimental science in the lunar environment, and exploration risk mitigation.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 1: artemis_science_objectives | Seven Artemis III science objectives
retrieved.text: The seven overarching Artemis III science objectives are understanding planetary processes, understanding the character and origin of lunar polar volatiles, interpreting the impact history of the Earth-Moon system, revealing the record of the ancient sun and astronomical environment, observing the universe and local space environment from a unique location, conducting experimental science in the lunar environment, and investigating and mitigating exploration risks.

generation.gold_context_answer:
The seven overarching Artemis III science objectives are:

1. Understanding planetary processes
2. Understanding the character and origin of lunar polar volatiles
3. Interpreting the impact history of the Earth-Moon system
4. Revealing the record of the ancient sun and astronomical environment
5. Observing the universe and local space environment from a unique location
6. Conducting experimental science in the lunar environment
7. Investigating and mitigating exploration risks
